title: 07227P0001-Modernized Commissary Operations
description_text: The New York City Department of Correction is requesting proposals for an all-purpose commissary vendor to supplement and modernize operations. The selected vendor would supply, store, fulfill, package, and deliver individualized commissary orders for Person-In Custody (hence forth referred to as PIC). There will be a Highly Recomended Pre-Proposal Conference for this solicitation on Monday, November 9, 2026 at 10:00 A.M.
